about: The terrain world (worlds/terrain) and the carve mechanic, measured 2026-10-14 by the terrain stream on Linux with a desktop GPU, headless Chrome 148 on the GPU (gpu-run.sh, CHROME_ARGS=--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl). The sheet beside this file shows only our own frames (top: examples/minimal/crater-isles at the reference framings, the kit's xk-terrain pictures; bottom: the two-player run, host and joiner from the same wide camera, the host's view, a late joiner) and no reference picture.

twoPlayers.how: node tests/terrain-two-players.mjs <crater-isles game> --shots <dir> (host and joiner over real WebRTC on this machine's signaling, the host lobbing 6 bombs with real mouse clicks; then a third player joins the running round)
twoPlayers.result: 6 of 6 steps: same generated ground (field hash ddb7a8ca on both); 6 craters carved; the joiner's field hash equal to the host's (3579d146) with all 6 applied live; the late joiner's equal after catching up from the host's log (asked once); no page errors

frameCost.how: window.__gfLook.perf(4000) on crater-isles alone with 3 bots, before and while bombs carve; the frame rate is held at 60 by the display rate, so p50/p95 show only that it never dropped a frame; renderCpuMs is the main thread's draw time
frameCost.notReal: no real phone and no GPU timer: the phone rows are emulated on the desktop GPU

artilleryCase.how: the wave-1 option B game (puff-artillery: the measured target's light, grade and ink, pilot-pack art) rebuilt on the terrain world: islands, the pilot's meadow top and seam-fixed meadow soil, xk-terrain rock strata on the cliffs, bombs that carve; rendered at four framings and scored by the look judge (builder/look/judge.mjs, measured part only: --no-vision), the same refs manifest and target as wave 1. The side-by-side with the references stays local, in a folder outside the repositories
artilleryCase.byEye: Closer in what dominates: islands with rounded grassy hills over strata cliffs standing in a sea, craters through soil, where wave 1 had a fenced yard. Still off: a pale flat sea and sky with no clouds, no pines or props on the islands, bean bodies, the HUD (other streams' levers). About 6/10 on the world and ground (wave 1: about 5/10 overall); the measured part rose 47 → 53–54, under the judge's bar of 55.
